notes.title: Game is live and ready for download!
notes.content:
After 11 months of off and on work, my latest offering is complete and ready for download! Get ready for some crazy demi-human action!

Also for one week enjoy the biggest discounts on my games ever! Up to 90% off for Ashmedai, if you have avoided her until now. Zuri's got a 80% discount, with a matching discount on the dlc! Give the whole assortment a look and buy what ya like.
